content: [CLS] busguardian “ every ride. every child. checked. “ presented by : nam e : ananya mishra role : graduate trainee engineer problem : school buses carry many children every day. a child may fall asleep and remain inside after the route ends. current safety checks rely on manual inspection. human error can cause these checks to fail. an automated system is needed to detect a child inside the bus. the system should trigger immediate alerts to prevent harm. m y solution : busgaurdian a multi layer safety system - “ busgaurdian ” system architecture “ tech + verification = no child left behind “ “ central controller : processes all safety signals ” solution description : the system works using three levels of detection : rfid tracking : students scan their rfid cards when entering and exiting the bus. the system keeps track of the total passenger count. seat detection : sensors installed under selected seats detect if any seat is still occupied after the route ends. driver walk check : when the bus is parked, an alarm prompts the driver to walk to the rear of the bus and press a verification button. “ if a child is detected or a passenger count mismatch occurs, the system immediately triggers a buzzer alarm and sends an sms alert to school authorities. ” “ this multi - layer verification approach reduces human error and ensures that every bus is checked before being locked. ” alert system entry / exit tracking driver walk checkdetection logic w orking : seat detection alert system when the bus route ends : the system detects the ignition off signal, or the driver presses the verification button. at this point, the system enters final safety check mode. esp32 control logic ( system logic ) entry / exit tracking logic the rfid reader receives card scan data from students. esp32 increases the entry count ( + 1 ) when a student boards the bus. when a student exits, the count decreases ( −1 ). the system continuously maintains the current passenger count. route end detection driver walk check login the driver presses the rear verification button after checking the bus. if the system detects : rfid mismatch + seat occupied then driver confirmation is required before closing the inspection. seat detection logicesp32 reads data from the seat sensors. seat occupied → true seat empty → false if any seat occupied = true, the system suspects that a child may still be inside the bus. alert logic if the system detects : passenger count mismatch or seat occupancy after route completion esp32 will : turn on the buzzer alarm inside the bus. trigger the gsm module to send an sms alert. costing and deployment : “ this low - cost setup makes the solution scalable and easy to deploy across large school bus fleets. ” total estimated cost ≈ ₹800 – ₹ 1000 per bus estimated installation time per bus ≈ 30 minutes per bus test scenarios [UNK] child sleeping → detected [UNK] rfid mismatch → seat sensors verify [UNK] empty bus → no alert [UNK] seat occupied → alarm triggered validation process simulated different scenarios such as sleeping child and empty bus. verified sensor response and alert triggering. ensured the system works even when the child is inactive. testing and validationsafety & operational reliability power system environmental reliability [UNK] high temperature [UNK] dust & vibration [UNK] low lighting privacy [UNK] no cameras [UNK] no video recording [UNK] only presence detection sensors ensures child privacy & data safety. “ w orks even after engine is off. ” bus batterysystem controller
